{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_vrtx_0115gw52NQkwFxitxc4MykTt","type":"tool_result","content":"components/Runs/Compare/ExecutionResults:\nDiffLegend.tsx\nDisplayPanel.tsx\nExecutionResultsTab.tsx\nMetricDeltaBadge\nRowCompareDetails\nconstants.ts\nmodels.ts\ntests\nutils\n\ncomponents/Runs/View:\nExtractionResult.tsx\nRowDetails\nTabsContent.tsx\nView.tsx\nmodels.ts\ntests\nuse-detail-mode.tsx\nuse-run-view-tab-state.ts\nutils.ts\n'use client';\n\nimport { ColDef } from 'ag-grid-community';\n\nimport { numberValueComparator } from '@/src/components/Grid/comparators/number-comparator';\nimport { currencyValueFormatter, numberValueFormatter, toNumberOrNull } from '@/src/constants/grid-columns/formatters';\nimport { GridColumnType } from '@/src/types/grid-column';\nimport { formatDateTimeToLocalString, toDateOrNull } from '@/src/utils/formatting/date';\n\nimport HeaderWithHintButton from '@/src/components/Grid/HeaderComponents/HeaderWithHintButton';\n\nexport const dateTimeColumn: Partial<ColDef> = {\n  valueFormatter: ({ value }) => formatDateTimeToLocalString(value),\n  filterValueGetter: (params) => toDateOrNull(params.data?.[params.colDef.field || '']),\n};\n\n/** Wider default for a name/ID column. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011Ch1c3UrVjyki6ajKT8FH1","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've fixed the header rows on both run-results tables: the run's results table (`current.png`) and the compare table (`mockup.png`). All 945 Runs and header tests pass, both typechecks report zero errors, and lint and prettier are clean. The Playwright server didn't connect this session, so I haven't checked the result in a browser.\n\n**What was wrong**\n- **Mixed label styles.** Columns with no custom header picked up the UI kit's grid style, which is 10px, uppercase and widely spaced (\"TEST CASE NAME\", \"TOTAL TURNS\", \"HTTP\", \"DURATION\"). Labels with a custom header that sits inside the kit's text styling came out 14px but still uppercase (\"# RUN NUM…\", \"SCORE\"). \"Total req…\" used a different header type, so it was the only label in normal case.\n- **Mixed group label weights.** \"Execution\" and \"Extracted\" were semi-bold, while metric groups like \"DeepEval: Answer Releva…\" were regular weight.\n- **Misaligned score labels.** A metric column took its alignment from the first row's value. When that row's metric had failed and was empty, \"SCORE\" sat at the left over right-aligned numbers. \"EXACT_MATCH\" was left-aligned the same way.\n- **Uneven rows on the compare table.** Its group rows were forced to 28px while the other header rows are 40px.\n\n**What I changed**\n- **One style for every label.** Every column and group label on both tables now renders through the same two header components.\n  - `EllipsisHeader` drops the inherited uppercase and letter spacing.\n  - `EllipsisHeaderGroup` is now semi-bold, matching the column labels.\n  - Both live in `components/Grid/HeaderComponents/`, and the shared settings are in `components/Runs/grid-column-layout.ts`.\n- **Right alignment.** All number columns (run number, request, turn, both totals, HTTP, duration, scores, Delta) have right-aligned labels. A metric now takes its alignment from the first row that has a value. A metric with no value on any row is still treated as a score column and aligned right.\n- **Even spacing.** I removed the 28px group-row override from the compare table, so every header row is 40px. That override was added for a third header level, which fits at 40px.\n- **Group name.** The \"INPUT BINDINGS\" group label is now \"Input bindings\", to match the letter case of the other groups.\n\nI updated the specs that used the old group name and added regression tests for label styling, alignment and the empty-first-row case."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":557,"cache_read_input_tokens":89286,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":557,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b24891c6-778d-4afe-99e4-0747d4193e7b","uuid":"cafeaa3b-b79c-44e7-bf69-3d123ae4368d","timestamp":"2026-11-13T21:04:03.320Z"}
